packages.title: Read-only extractor r2

requirements.execution: Compatible FYT lsec trigger and root access; availability does not confirm execution support

packages.readme:
EQ & DSP READ-ONLY EXTRACTOR r2

Always offered for collecting files when no patch matches or installation rejects signatures. This is the existing FYT lsec extraction procedure; being listed does not mean its launcher supports every unit. It requires the compatible firmware/updater trigger and root access. Unsupported units need a supported extraction method; do not run a guessed updater.

Use stable vehicle power and keep the correct firmware recovery package available. These procedures use the FYT lsec updater with root/system access, not Android's APK installer. ZIP download does not run any scripts.

Use a clean FAT32 USB drive. Copy the CONTENTS of ONE selected procedure folder to the USB root; never mix install, restore, uninstall or extractor launchers. Supply the compatible lsec6521update trigger from YOUR supported firmware/updater package at the USB root; it is not included. Do not substitute a trigger from another platform. Do not use firmware update images alongside these procedures. Insert USB and follow the supported unit's update procedure; do not interrupt power. Read the USB log after the reboot. A device model match alone does not establish compatibility.

Copy contents of USB-EXTRACT-DSP to USB root and add your compatible trigger. Script reads build properties, system/vendor audio libraries, DSP-related APK/JAR files, configuration and service listings. It writes only its report/copied files on USB and does not replace device libraries or app files. See extract.sh for the collection list. Logs/filenames can contain identifiers or personal information: review output before manually submitting it for analysis. The app uploads no report. If extraction fails, retain the log. No system-file restore is required because extraction does not alter them.

packages.title: Install as System App — install / uninstall

requirements.firmware: Extracted Android 8.1 firmware; native patch requires exact four-file signatures

packages.readme:
Install as System App r1 — INSTALL and UNINSTALL

Existing supported FYT sp9853i_1h10 / sp9853i_1h10_vmm Android 8.1 (API 27) x86/x86_64 privileged-app procedures. Other units/Android 10/11 are unverified. Requires writable /system via the compatible FYT lsec updater; verified boot/read-only system/SELinux may block it. A profile match does not confirm prerequisites.

Use stable vehicle power and keep the correct firmware recovery package available. These procedures use the FYT lsec updater with root/system access, not Android's APK installer. ZIP download does not run any scripts.

Use a clean FAT32 USB drive. Copy the CONTENTS of ONE selected procedure folder to the USB root; never mix install, restore, uninstall or extractor launchers. Supply the compatible lsec6521update trigger from YOUR supported firmware/updater package at the USB root; it is not included. Do not substitute a trigger from another platform. Do not use firmware update images alongside these procedures. Insert USB and follow the supported unit's update procedure; do not interrupt power. Read the USB log after the reboot. A device model match alone does not establish compatibility.

INSTALL: put YOUR current signed EQ & DSP APK, named EQDSP.apk, into INSTALL/eqdsp-privileged/. No APK or signing key is included. Keep the same signing key as your installed version. Copy contents of INSTALL to USB root and add your compatible trigger. Installs /system/priv-app/EQDsp/EQDSP.apk and /system/etc/permissions/privapp-permissions-com.eqdsp.controller.xml, adjusts permissions and relabels them. Updater reboots. Back up your original APK and any existing privileged copy/permission file before replacing them. Check eqdsp-privileged-install.log after reboot.

UNINSTALL: copy contents of UNINSTALL to clean USB root and add compatible trigger. Removes only EQDsp/EQDspV114 privileged app folders and the EQ & DSP permission allowlist. Leaves app data/presets and unrelated native patches alone. Check eqdsp-system-uninstall.log and reboot. Install the same signed APK normally for a user app. Removal does not restore a previously overwritten privileged version: reinstall retained originals/firmware if needed. Boot failure requires your unit's firmware recovery procedure.

packages.title: Visualizer 4096 r1.1 — install / restore

requirements.firmware: Extracted Android 8.1 firmware; native patch requires exact four-file signatures

packages.readme:
Visualizer 4096 r1.1 — install and restore

For the extracted FYT sp9853i_1h10 / sp9853i_1h10_vmm x86/x86_64 Android 8.1 (API 27) firmware ONLY. Exact original or already-patched hashes of all four libraries must match PATCH-MANIFEST.json. Unknown/unreadable files are not confirmed compatible. Do not run on Android 10/11 or a different firmware signature.

Use stable vehicle power and keep the correct firmware recovery package available. These procedures use the FYT lsec updater with root/system access, not Android's APK installer. ZIP download does not run any scripts.

Use a clean FAT32 USB drive. Copy the CONTENTS of ONE selected procedure folder to the USB root; never mix install, restore, uninstall or extractor launchers. Supply the compatible lsec6521update trigger from YOUR supported firmware/updater package at the USB root; it is not included. Do not substitute a trigger from another platform. Do not use firmware update images alongside these procedures. Insert USB and follow the supported unit's update procedure; do not interrupt power. Read the USB log after the reboot. A device model match alone does not establish compatibility.

INSTALL: copy contents of USB-INSTALL to USB root, add the correct trigger and run the supported updater. RESTORE: use USB-RESTORE instead. Scripts verify payload and device SHA-256 before writes, reject mismatches, back up originals to eqdsp-visualizer4096-backup-r1 on USB, stage replacements, verify committed files and roll back on failure. Keep the backup, original payload and restore procedure. A failed restore or boot failure needs the correct firmware recovery procedure.

Changes /system/lib/libmedia.so, /system/lib64/libmedia.so and both /vendor/lib*/soundfx/libvisualizer.so. Allows opt-in waveform capture up to 4096; the advertised default remains 1024 and native FFT is guarded above 1024. The app performs its own FFT. Replacing audio libraries may prevent boot/audio if incompatible. Installer rechecks signatures at execution time, even after the app checks them. On rejection, use the read-only extractor and submit reviewed output; do not bypass checks.
